name: leo-starter-portfolio
title: Leo's starter: Portfolio
description: A personal portfolio site with a three.js hero, GSAP scroll motion, light and dark themes, and all content in one file.
license: MIT (template code). Vendored GSAP uses the Standard No Charge GSAP License, see NOTICE.md.
author: Cardzo
features: Hero, about, selected work, experience timeline, contact and footer sections
3D low-poly hero that reacts to pointer and scroll, lazy loaded, capped pixel ratio, paused off screen
Static artwork fallback when WebGL is missing, reduced motion is on, or the page is opened from disk
GSAP intro and ScrollTrigger section motion with a reduced-motion path
CSS scroll-driven reading progress bar as progressive enhancement
Light and dark themes that follow the system setting
Active nav highlight, smooth anchor scrolling, mobile menu
mailto link and copy-email button, no backend
Self-hosted fonts, no trackers, no external requests

demo.quick: Double-click index.html (3D hero shows its static fallback from disk)
